falsification.hypothesis: A finite sparse sampled or narrow-band level-set pipeline can be the sole authoritative MC-1 material and engineering-output representation for the admitted domain.
falsification.criterion: Reject the total-authority role if finite sampling, resampling, interpolation or extraction can leave positive material, exact-zero contact, topology or source-faithful boundary location unresolved without an independent exact or outward-certified relation.
decisive_observations: Finite sign samples do not determine sub-cell material topology: a positive-volume feature may lie wholly between sampled nodes with identical corner signs.
A scalar geometric error bound does not certify discrete topology, durable body identity, lineage or exact-zero contact.
Resampling and surface extraction add independent approximation terms that cannot be silently folded into the source sweep error.
Refinement can reduce certified uncertainty but finite resolution alone cannot promote an approximation to exact canonical material truth.

terms.e_source: inherited source-sweep enclosure/error; never reset by voxelization
terms.e_sampling: certified bound from sampling/reconstruction inside each represented cell
terms.e_extraction: additional bound for isosurface/mesh extraction or downstream conversion

topology_contract.required_for_discrete_claims: independent exact/certified topology and body-lineage witness

refinement.claim: smaller pitch is not an exactness certificate and does not establish topology unless the feature/event is independently witnessed

protected_semantics: canonical operation journal remains authoritative and immutable
positive-volume material may not be deleted by pitch, band width, tolerance or extraction
durable body identity and lineage remain journal/certificate owned rather than voxel-component owned
STEP remains mandatory primary engineering output; extracted mesh/isosurface is not a substitute

requirements: explicit e_source, e_sampling, e_resampling and e_extraction certificate
fail closed on unresolved positive-volume or exact-zero distinctions
independent topology/body-lineage witness for discrete claims
failure dispatch is non-cycling and preserves the original request
